Search tooling was down for this batch (DuckDuckGo/searx returned 'Connection refused' on both queries), and volza, eximpedia and trademo free views all returned HTTP 403. Domestic supply therefore cannot be confirmed or ruled out from public sources in this pass.
note: The declared HS codes (292149; 293329; 293339; 293349) are nitrogen-function/heterocyclic compounds, but the only HS codes actually observed in the customs rows are 29232010 (soya lecithins), 29339990, 29420090 and 30049029 — i.e. the declared codes are not corroborated by any visible record. Critically, the observed trade is import-side: this entity appears in the data as an Indian buyer of APIs/excipients from Italy, China, Egypt and Romania, with counterparties including Caffaro Industrie S.p.A., Prisun Pharmatech, Ruiyixiang Hangzhou and Tre Emme Semimat. No export bill of lading, no destination country and no date of outbound shipment was found, so per Rule 5 the correct statement is: следов экспортных поставок не найдено. This is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base; the HS codes should be corrected to the factually observed ones (29232010, 29339990, 29420090, 30049029) and the verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected.
